metadata.title: Lewis (2003) Current Biology — Autoinhibition with Transcriptional Delay: her1/her7 Delay Differential Oscillator & DeltaC-Notch Synchronization in Zebrafish Somitogenesis

zebrafish_somites_specimen.species: Vertebrate embryo dorsal scanning electron micrograph showing central neural tube, presomitic mesoderm, and bilateral segmented somite metameres
zebrafish_somites_specimen.species_note_pass3: The Wikimedia Commons source title identifies this micrograph as a CHICK (Gallus gallus) embryo, not Danio rerio. It is used as a cross-species proxy for vertebrate somite metamerism; no zebrafish her1 in situ / PSM image is vendored yet (carried as a Pass 4 remediation item). The file name 'zebrafish_somites_specimen.jpg' is retained because its SHA-256 is pinned.

lewis_2003_governing_equations.protein_dde: dp(t)/dt = a * m(t - T_p) - b * p(t)
lewis_2003_governing_equations.total_delay_invariance: T_tot = T_m + T_p  (time-shift p_tilde(t) = p(t + T_p) reduces the DDE system to a single lumped delay T_tot)
lewis_2003_governing_equations.hopf_critical_delay_condition: T_tot > T_crit, where T_crit solves (omega^2 + b^2)*(omega^2 + c^2) = K_loop^2 and omega*T_crit = pi - arctan(omega/b) - arctan(omega/c) around the fixed point (m*, p*); for the canonical parameters T_crit = 7.54 min (computed in 2003-lewis-her1-her7-delayed-oscillator.py; the '~4.62 min' quoted in the v1/v2 dataset was not derived from this linearization and has been retired)
lewis_2003_governing_equations.box1_period_law_caveat: The Box 1 law T_osc = 2*(T_m + T_p + ln2/b + ln2/c) is an approximation; the RK4 DDE integration with the canonical parameters gives 33.6 min (12% above 30.0 min).
lewis_2003_governing_equations.oscillation_period_law: T_osc = 2 * (T_m + T_p + tau_half_p + tau_half_m) ~ 2 * (T_m + T_p + ln(2)/b + ln(2)/c) ~ 30.0 min
lewis_2003_governing_equations.deltac_notch_intercellular_coupling: dm_i(t)/dt = k * [ (1 - eps_N) + eps_N * (p_delta_neighbor(t - T_N) / p_delta0)^m_N / (1 + (p_delta_neighbor(t - T_N) / p_delta0)^m_N) ] / (1 + (p_i(t - T_m) / p_0)^n) - c * m_i(t)

canonical_zebrafish_parameters_28C.species: Danio rerio (zebrafish presomitic mesoderm at 28.5 C)

lewis_2003_experimental_perturbations.source: Lewis (2003) Current Biology 13:1398-1408 Table 1, Box 1 & Figs. 2-6; Giudicelli et al. (2007) PLoS Biology 5:e150; Herrgen et al. (2010) Current Biology 20:1244-1253
lewis_2003_experimental_perturbations.predicted_period_min_caveat: predicted_period_min values are TABULATED Box 1 estimates written when the dataset assumed T_crit ~ 4.62 min; they are not computed by the script. With the computed T_crit = 7.54 min the her7_fast_feedback_branch regime (T_tot = 6.3 min) is Hopf-subcritical and the model predicts a damped clock (0.0 min). The script reports tabulated, Box-1-computed and RK4-DDE periods side by side (Pass 3).

regimes.label: Wild-type Danio rerio PSM oscillator (her1/her7 feedback + DeltaC-Notch coupling at 28 C)
Pure her7 fast feedback loop (short gene delay T_m = 4.6 min, T_p = 1.7 min)
Pure her1 slow feedback loop (long gene delay T_m = 9.5 min, T_p = 2.8 min)
DeltaC-Notch intercellular delay elevation (Herrgen et al. 2010 collective period lengthening)
Subcritical delay (T_tot = 2.0 min < T_crit) or Cycloheximide translation block (a = 0 -> damped/arrested clock)

schroter_2012_dimer_truth_table.source: Schroter C, Ares S, Morelli LG, Isakova A, Koo B-K, Julicher F, Oates AC (2012) PLoS Biology 10(7):e1001364, Figs. 2-3 (yeast two-hybrid dimerization and EMSA DNA binding of Her1, Her7 and Hes6 bHLH dimers) and Figs. 5-7 (hes6 expression gradient and genetic interactions)
schroter_2012_dimer_truth_table.encoding_note: Hand-encoded binary DNA-binding matrix (1 = repressive DNA-binding dimer, 0 = non-binding). The paper reports binding qualitatively; dissociation constants are not tabulated there, so K_dim_her1_her1 and K_dim_her7_hes6 below are reduced model parameters of this repository.
schroter_2012_dimer_truth_table.repression_functional: Rep = [Her1:Her1]/K_11 + [Her7:Hes6]/K_76 with [A:B] = A*B (fast mass-action dimerization); her1, her7 and deltaC transcription = k * G_N(NICD) / (1 + Rep(t - T_m,gene)/P_0)
schroter_2012_dimer_truth_table.hes6_gradient: Hes6 is non-oscillating and graded along the PSM (posterior-high): Hes6(x) = H_ant + (H_post - H_ant) * x / (n_cols - 1), column 0 = anterior
schroter_2012_dimer_truth_table.predicted_direction: posterior (Hes6-high) cells are repressed through the short-delay Her7:Hes6 loop and cycle faster; anterior (Hes6-low) cells rely on the long-delay Her1 homodimer loop and cycle slower; hes6-null tissue is AP-uniform at the her1-only period

lattice_model_parameters.description: Pass 3 2D multicellular her1/her7/deltaC DDE lattice (simulate_her1_her7_lattice) with delayed DeltaC translation and NICD cleavage kinetics; 7 delayed state variables per cell, Heun method-of-steps, Langevin mRNA noise. Values must match LATTICE_DEFAULTS in the script (asserted by --self-test).

provenance.her1_her7_delays: slow/fast-branch delays of lewis_2003_experimental_perturbations (her1: 9.5 + 2.8 min; her7: 4.6 + 1.7 min)
provenance.deltaC_delays: long-gene estimates of the kind used by Lewis (2003) for the coupled-cell simulations (approximate; T_mD = 16.0 min, T_pD = 20.5 min)
provenance.T_N_k_N_b_N_K_D_N_0_h: reduced NICD cleavage/trafficking kinetics of this repository (not tabulated in the sources)
provenance.noise_heterogeneity: calibrated so that the eps_N = 0 lattice keeps 5-7 anterior cycles coherent (Lewis 2003 Figs. 5-6; seeds 2003/7/11 give 7/7/5)
